        "contents": "# Extracted Database Models\n\nThis directory contains Xata database models extracted from chat conversations. These files implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Files Extracted\n\n1. &#96;personnel.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the personnel table\n2. &#96;organizations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the organizations table\n3. &#96;sightings.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the sightings table\n4. &#96;documents.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the documents table\n5. &#96;locations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the locations table\n6. &#96;artifacts.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the artifacts table\n7. &#96;mindmaps.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the mindmaps table\n8. &#96;summary-files.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the summary-files table\n9. &#96;users.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the users table\n10. &#96;user-saved-items.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for various user-saved-* tables\n\n## Important Note\n\nThese files have import paths that need to be adjusted for your actual project structure. The current imports are:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { getXataClient, ... } from \"../xata\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nor in the client.ts file:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { XataClient } from \"@/xata\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou may need to adjust these paths based on where these files are placed in your project.\n\n## Client.ts\n\nThe &#96;client.ts&#96; file was extracted from the history file &#96;2025-05-04_15-52-xata-client-import-vs-instantiation.md&#96;. It provides a singleton pattern for the Xata client that can be used in two ways:\n\n1. Importing and using the &#96;getXataClient()&#96; function to get the client instance\n2. Directly importing the &#96;xata&#96; instance which is initialized on module load\n\nAccording to the history file, directly importing the client instance is slightly better in most cases for cleaner and more concise code.\n",

        "originalContents": "# Extracted Database Models\n\nThis directory contains Xata database models extracted from chat conversations. These files implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Files Extracted\n\n1. &#96;personnel.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the personnel table\n2. &#96;organizations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the organizations table\n3. &#96;sightings.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the sightings table\n4. &#96;documents.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the documents table\n5. &#96;locations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the locations table\n6. &#96;artifacts.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the artifacts table\n7. &#96;mindmaps.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the mindmaps table\n8. &#96;summary-files.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the summary-files table\n9. &#96;users.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the users table\n10. &#96;user-saved-items.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for various user-saved-* tables\n\n## Important Note\n\nThese files have import paths that need to be adjusted for your actual project structure. The current imports are:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { getXataClient, ... } from \"../xata\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nor in the client.ts file:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { XataClient } from \"@/xata\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou may need to adjust these paths based on where these files are placed in your project.\n\n## Client.ts\n\nThe &#96;client.ts&#96; file was extracted from the history file &#96;2025-05-04_15-52-xata-client-import-vs-instantiation.md&#96;. It provides a singleton pattern for the Xata client that can be used in two ways:\n\n1. Importing and using the &#96;getXataClient()&#96; function to get the client instance\n2. Directly importing the &#96;xata&#96; instance which is initialized on module load\n\nAccording to the history file, directly importing the client instance is slightly better in most cases for cleaner and more concise code.\n",

[rules] : [],\n\t\t\t\t}),\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tif (!response.ok) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(\"Failed to initiate streaming query\");\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Return the initial response\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: true,\n\t\t\tstreamUrl: \"/api/sse/xata/ask\",\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error initiating streaming query:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: false,\n\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t};\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function fetchNextMindmapRecords(\n\tparams: FetchNextMindmapRecordsParams,\n): Promise\u003cFetchNextMindmapRecordsResult\u003e {\n\tconst { table, size, offset, cursor } = params;\n\n\t// Type-safe way to access the table\n\tconst xataTable = xata.db[table as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataTable:\", xataTable);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Get the dynamic table from xata client\n\n\t\tif (!xataTable) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Table ${table} not found in Xata database&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Offset-based pagination (for initial load or specific positions)\n\t\t// Define the response type\n\t\ttype XataResponse = {\n\t\t\trecords: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tid: string;\n\t\t\t\t[key: string]: unknown;\n\t\t\t\txata: {\n\t\t\t\t\tversion: number;\n\t\t\t\t\tcreatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tupdatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t}\u003e;\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tpage?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcursor: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tmore: boolean;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst response: XataResponse = await xataTable.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Extract records and convert to serializable format\n\t\tconst serializableRecords = response.records.map((record) =\u003e\n\t\t\trecord.toSerializable(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Convert to mind map nodes\n\t\tconst nodes = serializableRecords.map(\n\t\t\t(record: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record),\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record).data,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: table,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tcursor: response.meta.page?.cursor,\n\t\t\t\tmore: response.meta.page?.more,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error fetching records from ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport async function fetchNextMindmapRecords(\n\tparams: FetchNextMindmapRecordsParams,\n): Promise\u003cFetchNextMindmapRecordsResult\u003e {\n\tconst { table, size, offset, cursor } = params;\n\n\t// Type-safe way to access the table\n\tconst xataTable = xata.db[table as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataTable:\", xataTable);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Get the dynamic table from xata client\n\n\t\tif (!xataTable) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Table ${table} not found in Xata database&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Offset-based pagination (for initial load or specific positions)\n\t\t// Define the response type\n\t\ttype XataResponse = {\n\t\t\trecords: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tid: string;\n\t\t\t\t[key: string]: unknown;\n\t\t\t\txata: {\n\t\t\t\t\tversion: number;\n\t\t\t\t\tcreatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tupdatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t}\u003e;\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tpage?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcursor: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tmore: boolean;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst response: XataResponse = await xataTable.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Extract records and convert to serializable format\n\t\tconst serializableRecords = response.records.map((record) =\u003e\n\t\t\trecord.toSerializable(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Convert to mind map nodes\n\t\tconst nodes = serializableRecords.map(\n\t\t\t(record: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record),\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record).data,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: table,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tcursor: response.meta.page?.cursor,\n\t\t\t\tmore: response.meta.page?.more,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error fetching records from ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "import { xata } from \"../client\";\n\nexport const searchXata = async ({\n\tquery,\n\tid,\n\ttable,\n}: {\n\tquery: string;\n\tid?: string | null;\n\ttable?: string | null;\n}) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif (!query) {\n\t\t\treturn { success: false, error: \"Query is required\" };\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlet searchResults;\n\n\t\tif (table \u0026\u0026 id) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table and record\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.db[table].search(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else if (table) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\ttables: [{ table }],\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t// Global search across all tables\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: true,\n\t\t\tsearchResults: searchResults.records || searchResults,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Search error:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: false,\n\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t};\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Enhanced Ask Xata function with full SDK support\n * Supports all Xata Ask SDK features including rules, search types, boosters, and filters\n */\nexport const askXata = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions?: {\n\t\trules?: string[];\n\t\tsearchType?: string;\n\t\tsearch?: any;\n\t\tvectorSearch?: any;\n\t\tsessionId?: string;\n\t},\n) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst askOptions = {\n\t\t\trules: options?.rules || [],\n\t\t\tsearchType: options?.searchType || \"table\",\n\t\t\tsearch: options?.search,\n\t\t\tvectorSearch: options?.vectorSearch,\n\t\t\tsessionId: options?.sessionId,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst result = await xataClient.db[table].ask(question, askOptions);\n\t\treturn result;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error asking Xata:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n};",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Enhanced Ask Xata function with full SDK support\n * Supports all Xata Ask SDK features including rules, search types, boosters, and filters\n */\nexport const askXata = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions?: {\n\t\trules?: string[];\n\t\tsearchType?: string;\n\t\tsearch?: any;\n\t\tvectorSearch?: any;\n\t\tsessionId?: string;\n\t},\n) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst askOptions = {\n\t\t\trules: options?.rules || [],\n\t\t\tsearchType: options?.searchType || \"table\",\n\t\t\tsearch: options?.search,\n\t\t\tvectorSearch: options?.vectorSearch,\n\t\t\tsessionId: options?.sessionId,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst result = await xataClient.db[table].ask(question, askOptions);\n\t\treturn result;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error asking Xata:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Create a streaming ask request that returns the answer as a stream of events\n * Supports all the same options as the regular ask function\n */\nexport const askStream = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions: XataAskOptions = {},\n): Promise\u003cReadableStream\u003cAskStreamChunk\u003e\u003e =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Setting up headers for server-sent events\n\t\tconst fetchOptions: any = {\n\t\t\theaders: {\n\t\t\t\tAccept: \"text/event-stream\",\n\t\t\t\t\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Prepare the request body with all supported options\n\t\tconst requestBody: any = {\n\t\t\tquestion,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Add all optional parameters\n\t\tif (options.rules) requestBody.rules = options.rules;\n\t\tif (options.searchType) requestBody.searchType = options.searchType;\n\t\tif (options.search) requestBody.search = options.search;\n\t\tif (options.vectorSearch) requestBody.vectorSearch = options.vectorSearch;\n\n\t\tfetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(requestBody);\n\n\t\tlet url: string;\n\n\t\t// Determine if this is a new question or a follow-up\n\t\tif (options.sessionId) {\n\t\t\turl = &#96;${xataClient.fetch.baseURL}/db/${xataClient.databaseURL}/tables/${table}/ask/${options.sessionId}&#96;;\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\turl = &#96;${xataClient.fetch.baseURL}/db/${xataClient.databaseURL}/tables/${table}/ask&#96;;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Send the request\n\t\tconst response = await fetch(url, fetchOptions);\n\n\t\tif (!response.ok || !response.body) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Failed to stream response: ${response.statusText}&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Process and return the stream\n\t\treturn processStream(response.body);\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error streaming question:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n};",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Create a streaming ask request that returns the answer as a stream of events\n * Supports all the same options as the regular ask function\n */\nexport const askStream = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions: XataAskOptions = {},\n): Promise\u003cReadableStream\u003cAskStreamChunk\u003e\u003e =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Setting up headers for server-sent events\n\t\tconst fetchOptions: any = {\n\t\t\theaders: {\n\t\t\t\tAccept: \"text/event-stream\",\n\t\t\t\t\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Prepare the request body with all supported options\n\t\tconst requestBody: any = {\n\t\t\tquestion,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\t// Add all optional parameters\n\t\tif (options.rules) requestBody.rules = options.rules;\n\t\tif (options.searchType) requestBody.searchType = options.searchType;\n\t\tif (options.search) requestBody.search = options.search;\n\t\tif (options.vectorSearch) requestBody.vectorSearch = options.vectorSearch;\n\n\t\tfetchOptions.body = JSON.stringify(requestBody);\n\n\t\tlet url: string;\n\n\t\t// Determine if this is a new question or a follow-up\n\t\tif (options.sessionId) {\n\t\t\turl = &#96;${xataClient.fetch.baseURL}/db/${xataClient.databaseURL}/tables/${table}/ask/${options.sessionId}&#96;;\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\turl = &#96;${xataClient.fetch.baseURL}/db/${xataClient.databaseURL}/tables/${table}/ask&#96;;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Send the request\n\t\tconst response = await fetch(url, fetchOptions);\n\n\t\tif (!response.ok || !response.body) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Failed to stream response: ${response.statusText}&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Process and return the stream\n\t\treturn processStream(response.body);\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error streaming question:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Process the SSE response stream from Xata's ask endpoint\n */\nconst processStream = (stream: ReadableStream) =\u003e {\n\tconst reader = stream.getReader();\n\tconst decoder = new TextDecoder();\n\n\treturn new ReadableStream({\n\t\tasync start(controller) {\n\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\twhile (true) {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst { done, value } = await reader.read();\n\n\t\t\t\t\tif (done) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcontroller.close();\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\tconst chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n\t\t\t\t\tconst lines = chunk.split(\"\\n\");\n\n\t\t\t\t\tfor (const line of lines) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif (line.startsWith(\"data: \")) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconst data = line.slice(6); // Remove 'data: ' prefix\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconst parsedData = JSON.parse(data);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcontroller.enqueue(parsedData);\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// If this is the final chunk with done:true, close the stream\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif (parsedData.done) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcontroller.close();\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t} catch (e) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.error(\"Error parsing SSE data:\", e);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\t\tcontroller.error(error);\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t},\n\t});\n};",

        "contents": "# Xata Ask SDK - Comprehensive Implementation for UFO/UAP Research\n\n## Overview\n\nThis implementation provides a complete wrapper around Xata's Ask SDK with advanced features specifically designed for UFO/UAP research. It includes comprehensive search configurations, domain-specific rules, and specialized functions for different types of research scenarios.\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n1. [Core Features](#core-features)\n2. [Basic Usage](#basic-usage)\n3. [Advanced Features](#advanced-features)\n4. [UFO/UAP Research Enhancements](#ufo-uap-research-enhancements)\n5. [Research Conversation Builder](#research-conversation-builder)\n6. [Multi-table Research](#multi-table-research)\n7. [Streaming Capabilities](#streaming-capabilities)\n8. [Configuration Examples](#configuration-examples)\n9. [Best Practices](#best-practices)\n\n## Core Features\n\n### Basic Ask Functions\n- &#96;askXata()&#96; - Core function with full SDK support\n- &#96;askXataWithAi()&#96; - Enhanced version that fetches actual record data\n- &#96;askFollowUp()&#96; - Session-based follow-up questions\n- &#96;askXataComprehensive()&#96; - Full feature set matching SDK documentation\n- &#96;askStream()&#96; - Streaming responses for real-time updates\n\n### Enhanced Features\n- **Rules System**: Pre-configured AI guidance rules\n- **Search Types**: Keyword and vector search support\n- **Boosters**: Value and numeric boosters for relevance scoring\n- **Target Columns**: Weighted column targeting\n- **Session Management**: Conversation continuity\n- **Record Fetching**: Automatic conversion from IDs to full records\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### Simple Question\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { askXata } from '@db/xata/api';\n\nconst result = await askXata(\n  'events', \n  'What are the most credible UFO sightings?'\n);\n\nconsole.log(result.answer);\nconsole.log(&#96;Session ID: ${result.sessionId}&#96;);\nconsole.log(&#96;Found ${result.records.length} relevant records&#96;);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Getting Full Record Data\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { askXataWithAi } from '@db/xata/api';\n\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Multi-table research function that queries across events, personnel, and testimonies\n */\nexport const askMultiTableResearch = async (\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions: {\n\t\ttables?: string[];\n\t\tsessionId?: string;\n\t\tresearchType?: keyof typeof UFO_RESEARCH_RULES;\n\t} = {}\n): Promise\u003c{\n\tcombinedAnswer: string;\n\ttableResults: Record\u003cstring, AskResponseWithRecords\u003e;\n\tsessionId: string;\n}\u003e =\u003e {\n\tconst tables = options.tables || ['events', 'personnel', 'testimonies'];\n\tconst rules = UFO_RESEARCH_RULES[options.researchType || 'SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS'];\n\t\n\tconst results: Record\u003cstring, AskResponseWithRecords\u003e = {};\n\tlet sessionId = options.sessionId;\n\n\t// Query each table\n\tfor (const table of tables) {\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tconst result = await askXataWithAi({\n\t\t\t\ttable,\n\t\t\t\tquestion,\n\t\t\t\trules,\n\t\t\t\tsessionId\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\tresults[table] = result;\n\t\t\tsessionId = result.sessionId; // Use the session for follow-ups\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error querying table ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Combine results into a comprehensive answer\n\tconst combinedAnswer = Object.entries(results)\n\t\t.map(([table, result]) =\u003e &#96;**${table.toUpperCase()}**: ${result.answer}&#96;)\n\t\t.join('\\n\\n');\n\n\treturn {\n\t\tcombinedAnswer,\n\t\ttableResults: results,\n\t\tsessionId: sessionId || ''\n\t};\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Gets testimonies with pagination\n * @param page The page number (starting from 1)\n * @param size The page size\n * @param filter Optional filter expression\n * @param columns Optional columns to select\n * @returns Paginated response with testimony records\n */\nexport async function getTestimoniesWithPagination(\n\tpage = 1,\n\tsize = 20,\n\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e,\n\tcolumns?: string[],\n): Promise\u003cPaginatedTestimoniesResponse\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate input\n\t\tif (page \u003c 1) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Page number must be greater than 0\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_PAGE\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (size \u003c 1 || size \u003e 100) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Page size must be between 1 and 100\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_SIZE\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlet query = xata.db.testimonies.filter(filter || {});\n\n\t\tif (columns \u0026\u0026 columns.length \u003e 0) {\n\t\t\tquery = query.select(columns as any);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst result = await query.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\trecords: result.records as TestimoniesRecord[],\n\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\tpage,\n\t\t\t\tsize,\n\t\t\t\ttotal: undefined, // Xata doesn't provide total in current SDK version\n\t\t\t\thasNextPage: typeof result.hasNextPage === 'function' ? result.hasNextPage() : !!result.hasNextPage,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error getting paginated testimonies:\", error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get paginated testimonies: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"PAGINATION_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Gets testimonies with pagination\n * @param page The page number (starting from 1)\n * @param size The page size\n * @param filter Optional filter expression\n * @param columns Optional columns to select\n * @returns Paginated response with testimony records\n */\nexport async function getTestimoniesWithPagination(\n\tpage = 1,\n\tsize = 20,\n\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e,\n\tcolumns?: string[],\n): Promise\u003cPaginatedTestimoniesResponse\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate input\n\t\tif (page \u003c 1) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Page number must be greater than 0\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_PAGE\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif (size \u003c 1 || size \u003e 100) {\n\t\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t\t\"Page size must be between 1 and 100\",\n\t\t\t\t\"INVALID_SIZE\",\n\t\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlet query = xata.db.testimonies.filter(filter || {});\n\n\t\tif (columns \u0026\u0026 columns.length \u003e 0) {\n\t\t\tquery = query.select(columns as any);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst result = await query.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\trecords: result.records as TestimoniesRecord[],\n\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\tpage,\n\t\t\t\tsize,\n\t\t\t\ttotal: undefined, // Xata doesn't provide total in current SDK version\n\t\t\t\thasNextPage: typeof result.hasNextPage === 'function' ? result.hasNextPage() : !!result.hasNextPage,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error getting paginated testimonies:\", error);\n\n\t\tthrow createTestimonyError(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to get paginated testimonies: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\"PAGINATION_FAILED\",\n\t\t\t\"getTestimoniesWithPagination\",\n\t\t\terror,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "import {getXataClient} from '@/db/xata'\nconst xata = getXataClient()\n\nimport dynamic from 'next/dynamic'\nimport {Suspense} from 'react'\n\nconst Loading = dynamic(() =\u003e import('@/components/loaders/loading').then((mod) =\u003e mod.Loading))\n\nconst WordCloud = dynamic(() =\u003e\n  import('@/features/3d/visualizations/word-cloud').then((mod) =\u003e mod.WordCloud)\n)\n\nconst Spotlight = dynamic(() =\u003e\n  import('@/components/animated/spotlight').then((mod) =\u003e mod.Spotlight)\n)\n\nconst StarsBackground = dynamic(() =\u003e\n  import('@/components/backgrounds/shooting-stars').then((mod) =\u003e mod.StarsBackground)\n)\n\nimport {computeWordRefsWithPosition} from '@/utils/functions'\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  const events = await xata.db.events\n    .sort('date', 'desc')\n    .select(['name', 'location', 'photos', 'photos.signedUrl', 'photos.enablePublicUrl', 'date'])\n    .getAll()\n    .then((res) =\u003e\n      res.toSerializable().map(({xata: xataData, ...record}) =\u003e ({...record, type: 'events'}))\n    )\n\n  const topics = await xata.db.topics\n    .getAll()\n    .then((res) =\u003e\n      res.toSerializable().map(({xata: xataData, ...record}) =\u003e ({...record, type: 'topics'}))\n    )\n\n  const testimonies = await xata.db.testimonies\n    .select([\n      '*',\n      'witness.id',\n      'witness.name',\n      'witness.role',\n      'witness.photo',\n      'witness.photo.signedUrl',\n      'event.id',\n      'event.name',\n      'event.date',\n    ])\n    .getAll()\n    .then((res) =\u003e\n      res.toSerializable().map(({xata: xataData, ...record}) =\u003e ({\n        ...record,\n        type: 'testimonies',\n      }))\n    )\n\n  const organizations = await xata.db.organizations.getAll().then((res) =\u003e\n    res.toSerializable().map(({xata: xataData, ...record}) =\u003e ({\n      ...record,\n      type: 'organizations',\n    }))\n  )",

        "contents": "export default async function Index() {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const formatConnections = (connectionsArray: any) =\u003e {\n    return connectionsArray.map(({id, ...rest}: any) =\u003e {\n      const [sourceData, targetData] = Object.entries(rest)\n\n      const [sourceType, sourceObj]: any = sourceData\n      const [targetType, targetObj]: any = targetData\n\n      const sourceNodeExists = recordsWithoutPositioning.find(\n        (record) =\u003e record.id === sourceObj.id\n      )\n      console.log('sourceNodeExists: ', sourceNodeExists)\n      const targetNodeExists = recordsWithoutPositioning.find(\n        (record) =\u003e record.id === targetObj.id\n      )\n      console.log('targetNodeExists: ', targetNodeExists)\n\n      if (sourceNodeExists \u0026\u0026 targetNodeExists) {\n        const end = positionsByRecordId[targetNodeExists.id]\n        console.log('end: ', end)\n        const start = positionsByRecordId[sourceNodeExists.id]\n\n        console.log('start: ', start)\n        return {id, source: sourceObj.id, target: targetObj.id, start, end}\n      }\n    })\n  }\n  const connections = formatConnections([\n    ...topicsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...eventsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...organizationsMembers.toSerializable(),\n    ...eventsTopicsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...topicsTestimoniesConnections.toSerializable(),\n  ])\n\n  return (\n    // bg-dot-white/[0.2]\n    \u003cSuspense fallback={\u003cLoading /\u003e}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className='h-[100vw] overflow-hidden w-screen word-cloud-page bg-black relative '\u003e\n        \u003cSpotlight className='-top-40 left-0 md:left-60 md:-top-20' fill='white' /\u003e\n\n        \u003cWordCloud records={records} connections={connections} /\u003e\n        \u003cStarsBackground /\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/Suspense\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const formatConnections = (connectionsArray: any) =\u003e {\n    return connectionsArray.map(({id, ...rest}: any) =\u003e {\n      const [sourceData, targetData] = Object.entries(rest)\n\n      const [sourceType, sourceObj]: any = sourceData\n      const [targetType, targetObj]: any = targetData\n\n      const sourceNodeExists = recordsWithoutPositioning.find(\n        (record) =\u003e record.id === sourceObj.id\n      )\n      console.log('sourceNodeExists: ', sourceNodeExists)\n      const targetNodeExists = recordsWithoutPositioning.find(\n        (record) =\u003e record.id === targetObj.id\n      )\n      console.log('targetNodeExists: ', targetNodeExists)\n\n      if (sourceNodeExists \u0026\u0026 targetNodeExists) {\n        const end = positionsByRecordId[targetNodeExists.id]\n        console.log('end: ', end)\n        const start = positionsByRecordId[sourceNodeExists.id]\n\n        console.log('start: ', start)\n        return {id, source: sourceObj.id, target: targetObj.id, start, end}\n      }\n    })\n  }\n  const connections = formatConnections([\n    ...topicsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...eventsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...organizationsMembers.toSerializable(),\n    ...eventsTopicsExpertsConnections.toSerializable(),\n    ...topicsTestimoniesConnections.toSerializable(),\n  ])\n\n  return (\n    // bg-dot-white/[0.2]\n    \u003cSuspense fallback={\u003cLoading /\u003e}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className='h-[100vw] overflow-hidden w-screen word-cloud-page bg-black relative '\u003e\n        \u003cSpotlight className='-top-40 left-0 md:left-60 md:-top-20' fill='white' /\u003e\n\n        \u003cWordCloud records={records} connections={connections} /\u003e\n        \u003cStarsBackground /\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/Suspense\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nfunction Frame({ person, c = new THREE.Color(), ...props }: any) {\n  const image: any = useRef()\n  const frame: any = useRef()\n  // const [, params] = useRoute('/item/:id')\n  const [hovered, hover] = useState(false)\n  const [rnd] = useState(() =\u003e Math.random())\n  const name = person?.name\n  const isActive = false //params?.id === name\n  useCursor(hovered)\n  useFrame((state, dt) =\u003e {\n    image.current.material.zoom =\n      2 + Math.sin(rnd * 10000 + state.clock.elapsedTime / 3) / 2\n    easing.damp3(\n      image.current.scale,\n      [\n        0.85 * (!isActive \u0026\u0026 hovered ? 0.85 : 1),\n        0.9 * (!isActive \u0026\u0026 hovered ? 0.905 : 1),\n        1,\n      ],\n      0.1,\n      dt\n    )\n    easing.dampC(\n      frame.current.material.color,\n      hovered ? 'orange' : 'white',\n      0.1,\n      dt\n    )\n  })\n  return (\n    \u003cgroup {...props}\u003e\n      \u003cmesh\n        name={name}\n        onPointerOver={(e) =\u003e (e.stopPropagation(), hover(true))}\n        onPointerOut={() =\u003e hover(false)}\n        scale={[1, GOLDENRATIO, 0.05]}\n        position={[0, GOLDENRATIO / 2, 0]}\n      \u003e\n        \u003cboxGeometry /\u003e\n        \u003cmeshStandardMaterial\n          color='#151515'\n          metalness={0.5}\n          roughness={0.5}\n          envMapIntensity={2}\n        /\u003e\n        \u003cmesh\n          ref={frame}\n          raycast={() =\u003e null}\n          scale={[0.9, 0.93, 0.9]}\n          position={[0, 0, 0.2]}\n        \u003e\n          \u003cboxGeometry /\u003e\n          \u003cmeshBasicMaterial toneMapped={false} fog={false} /\u003e\n        \u003c/mesh\u003e\n        \u003cImage\n          raycast={() =\u003e null}\n          ref={image}\n          position={[0, 0, 0.7]}\n          url={url}\n        /\u003e\n      \u003c/mesh\u003e\n      \u003cText\n        maxWidth={0.1}\n        anchorX='left'\n        anchorY='top'\n        position={[0.55, GOLDENRATIO, 0]}\n        fontSize={0.025}\n      \u003e\n        {name.split('-').join(' ')}\n      \u003c/Text\u003e\n    \u003c/group\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const MindMapBottomMenu = ({\n  onCommandChange,\n  onModelChange,\n}: MindMapBottomMenuProps = {}) =\u003e {\n  // Get session ID for the current user/session\n  const sessionId = useRef\u003cstring\u003e(\n    typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sessionId') || uuidv4() : uuidv4()\n  )\n\n  // Store session ID in localStorage if it's new\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' \u0026\u0026 !localStorage.getItem('sessionId')) {\n      localStorage.setItem('sessionId', sessionId.current)\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  const {\n    status: chatStatus,\n    messages,\n    input,\n    setInput,\n    submitMessage,\n    handleInputChange,\n    append,\n    error,\n  } = useAssistant({\n    api: '/api/disclosure/chat',\n    headers: {\n      'x-session-id': sessionId.current,\n    },\n  })\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ MindMapBottomMenu ~ input:', input)\n\n  // Keep inputValue in sync with useAssistant input, but avoid infinite loops\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    setInputValue(input)\n  }, [input])\n\n  // Save messages to localStorage when they change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (messages.length \u003e 0 \u0026\u0026 typeof window !== 'undefined') {\n      localStorage.setItem('chatMessages', JSON.stringify(messages))\n    }\n  }, [messages])\n\n  // Handle assistant errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Assistant error:', error)\n      // Display error to user - could use a toast library here\n    }\n  }, [error])\n\n  const {\n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    loadNodesFromTableQuery,\n    addConnectionNodesFromSearch,\n    addUserInputNode,\n    addNodes,\n    updateNodeData,\n    addEdges,\n    screenToFlowPosition,\n    retrieveEntitiesFromStore,\n\n    setEdges,\n    setNodes,\n    getNodes,\n    addNode,\n\n    getNode,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  const idCounter = useRef(0)\n  const getNextId = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    idCounter.current += 1\n    return &#96;userInputNode-${idCounter.current}&#96;\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport {useCallback, useEffect, useState} from 'react'\nimport {type MindMapNode, fetchNextMindmapRecords} from '../actions/fetch-next-mindmap-records'\n\n// Define constants outside component to avoid dependency issues\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 3\n\nexport function MindmapExplorer({initialTable = 'topics'}: {initialTable?: string}) {\n  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState\u003cMindMapNode[]\u003e([])\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [table, setTable] = useState(initialTable)\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(0)\n  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState\u003cstring | undefined\u003e(undefined)\n\n  const loadMoreNodes = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true)\n      setError(null)\n\n      // Call the server action directly from the client component\n      const result = await fetchNextMindmapRecords({\n        table,\n        size: PAGE_SIZE,\n        offset: page * PAGE_SIZE,\n        cursor,\n      })\n\n      // Update the nodes state with the returned nodes\n      setNodes((prev) =\u003e [...prev, ...result.nodes])\n\n      // Save the cursor for the next request\n      setCursor(result.meta.cursor)\n\n      // Increment page counter\n      setPage((prev) =\u003e prev + 1)\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Failed to fetch mindmap nodes:', err)\n      setError('Failed to load more nodes. Please try again.')\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }, [table, cursor, page])\n\n  // Initial load\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (nodes.length === 0) {\n      loadMoreNodes()\n    }\n  }, [nodes.length, loadMoreNodes])\n\n  // Change table handler\n  const handleTableChange = (newTable: string) =\u003e {\n    setNodes([])\n    setPage(0)\n    setCursor(undefined)\n    setTable(newTable)\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const AskAIStreaming: React.FC\u003cAskAIStreamingProps\u003e = ({\n  question,\n  table,\n  rules = [],\n  nodeId,\n  onComplete,\n  onError,\n}) =\u003e {\n  console.log('🚀 ~ table:', table)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ question:', question)\n\n  const endpoint = '/api/sse/xata/ask'\n  const {streaming, isConnected, error, records, isComplete, postQuery} = useSSE(endpoint)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ isConnected:', isConnected)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ streaming:', streaming)\n\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('idle')\n\n  // For debugging - log state changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('AskAIStreaming state update:', {\n      status,\n      isConnected,\n      streamingLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n      recordCount: records?.length || 0,\n      isComplete\n    });\n  }, [status, isConnected, streaming, records, isComplete]);\n\n  // Start the query when the component mounts\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (question \u0026\u0026 table) {\n      console.log(&#96;Starting query for: ${table} - ${question.substring(0, 50)}&#96;);\n      setStatus('loading')\n      postQuery(question, table, rules).then((success) =\u003e {\n        console.log(&#96;Query initialization ${success ? 'successful' : 'failed'}&#96;);\n        if (success) {\n          setStatus('streaming');\n        } else {\n          setStatus('error');\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [question, table, rules, postQuery])\n\n  // Only notify parent when complete or error\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (isComplete \u0026\u0026 onComplete \u0026\u0026 streaming) {\n      console.log('Stream complete! Notifying parent with:', {\n        answerLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n        recordCount: records?.length || 0\n      });\n      \n      onComplete({\n        answer: streaming,\n        entities: records || [],\n      });\n      \n      setStatus('complete');\n    }\n  }, [isComplete, streaming, records, onComplete])\n\n  // Handle errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error \u0026\u0026 onError) {\n      onError(error)\n    }\n  }, [error, onError])",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const AskAIStreaming: React.FC\u003cAskAIStreamingProps\u003e = ({\n  question,\n  table,\n  rules = [],\n  nodeId,\n  onComplete,\n  onError,\n}) =\u003e {\n  console.log('🚀 ~ table:', table)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ question:', question)\n\n  const endpoint = '/api/sse/xata/ask'\n  const {streaming, isConnected, error, records, isComplete, postQuery} = useSSE(endpoint)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ isConnected:', isConnected)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ streaming:', streaming)\n\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('idle')\n\n  // For debugging - log state changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('AskAIStreaming state update:', {\n      status,\n      isConnected,\n      streamingLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n      recordCount: records?.length || 0,\n      isComplete\n    });\n  }, [status, isConnected, streaming, records, isComplete]);\n\n  // Start the query when the component mounts\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (question \u0026\u0026 table) {\n      console.log(&#96;Starting query for: ${table} - ${question.substring(0, 50)}&#96;);\n      setStatus('loading')\n      postQuery(question, table, rules).then((success) =\u003e {\n        console.log(&#96;Query initialization ${success ? 'successful' : 'failed'}&#96;);\n        if (success) {\n          setStatus('streaming');\n        } else {\n          setStatus('error');\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [question, table, rules, postQuery])\n\n  // Only notify parent when complete or error\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (isComplete \u0026\u0026 onComplete \u0026\u0026 streaming) {\n      console.log('Stream complete! Notifying parent with:', {\n        answerLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n        recordCount: records?.length || 0\n      });\n      \n      onComplete({\n        answer: streaming,\n        entities: records || [],\n      });\n      \n      setStatus('complete');\n    }\n  }, [isComplete, streaming, records, onComplete])\n\n  // Handle errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error \u0026\u0026 onError) {\n      onError(error)\n    }\n  }, [error, onError])",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport { ReactNode, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { useMindMap } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { XYPosition } from '@xyflow/react'\n\n/**\n * SmartGraph - A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap graph\n * by providing custom context to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartGraph({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  // Get the mind map context\n  const mindMapContext = useMindMap()\n  \n  // Get the nodes and edges from the mind map context\n  const { \n    nodes, \n    edges, \n    activeNode, \n    addUserInputNode, \n    findConnections, \n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    organizeLayout,\n    updateNodeData,\n    fitView,\n    deleteNode\n  } = mindMapContext\n  \n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Define functions that can be called by the assistant\n  const handleAddNote = useCallback((input: string, position?: XYPosition) =\u003e {\n    // Default position to center of viewport if not provided\n    const centerPosition = position || { x: 0, y: 0 }\n    \n    // Create a new user input node\n    const newNode = addUserInputNode({\n      input,\n      user: 'Assistant',\n      position: centerPosition\n    })\n    \n    // Focus the view on the new node\n    setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      fitView({ padding: 0.2, includeHiddenNodes: false })\n    }, 100)\n    \n    return newNode\n  }, [addUserInputNode, fitView])\n  \n  const handleFindConnections = useCallback((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    const node = nodes.find(n =\u003e n.id === nodeId)\n    if (!node) return { success: false, message: 'Node not found' }\n    \n    const connections = findConnections(node)\n    return { \n      success: true, \n      connections,\n      message: &#96;Found ${connections.length} connections for node ${nodeId}&#96;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, findConnections])",

        "contents": "import {MindMapBottomMenu} from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/mindmap-bottom-menu'\nimport {useAssistantInstructions} from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport function BottomMenuAiWrapped() {\n  useAssistantInstructions({\n    instruction: &#96;\n     # MindMapBottomMenu: Logic, Features, Behavior, and Data Flow\n\n## Overview\n\n\\&#96;MindMapBottomMenu\\&#96; is a highly interactive, stateful React component (Next.js 15, functional style) that serves as the primary AI/Oracle input and control bar for the Mind Map feature. It orchestrates user input, AI chat, database search, and dynamic mind map graph updates, integrating with multiple contexts, actions, and UI modules.\n\n---\n\n## Key Modules and Architecture\n\n- **Contexts**\n  - \\&#96;useMindMap\\&#96;: Provides all graph manipulation and data loading functions (nodes, edges, queries, etc.).\n  - \\&#96;useSessionNotes\\&#96;: Allows saving AI chat messages as session notes.\n\n- **Actions**\n  - \\&#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery\\&#96;: Triggers a search/query against a database table.\n  - \\&#96;xataToXYFlow\\&#96;: Converts database/AI results into graph nodes/edges for visualization.\n  - \\&#96;askAIAction\\&#96;: Sends a question to the AI for a specific table/model.\n\n- **AI Integration**\n  - \\&#96;useAssistant\\&#96; (from \\&#96;@ai-sdk/react\\&#96;): Manages AI chat state, message history, input, and error handling.\n\n- **UI Components**\n  - \\&#96;OracleInput\\&#96;: Input field with command/model context.\n  - \\&#96;OracleCommandMenu\\&#96;: Command palette for selecting actions (chat, search, scrape, etc.).\n  - \\&#96;UltraterrestrialModelSelection\\&#96;: Model/entity type selector.\n  - \\&#96;MindMapMessages\\&#96;: Renders chat/AI messages.\n  - \\&#96;SessionNotes\\&#96;: Displays session notes.\n\n---\n\n## Features and Behaviors\n\n### 1. **Session and Message Persistence**\n- Generates or retrieves a unique session ID (UUID) per user/session, stored in \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;.\n- Persists chat messages to \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Mindmap with Assistant UI Integration\n\nThis directory contains the mindmap visualization components and integration with Assistant UI.\n\n## AI-Enhanced Graph Features\n\nThe AIEnabledGraph component wraps the standard Graph component with Assistant UI context awareness, enabling:\n\n1. Contextual AI assistance based on the current graph state\n2. Intelligent suggestions based on visible nodes and connections\n3. Direct AI interaction with the graph through function calling\n\n## Usage Example\n\nTo use the AI-enabled graph in a page:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use client'\n\nimport { MindMapProvider } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { AIEnabledGraph } from '@/features/mindmap/smart-graph'\nimport { AssistantProvider } from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport default function MindmapPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cAssistantProvider\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapProvider\u003e\n        \u003cAIEnabledGraph /\u003e\n      \u003c/MindMapProvider\u003e\n    \u003c/AssistantProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## How It Works\n\nThe implementation uses two key Assistant UI patterns:\n\n### 1. Model Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Dynamically exposes the current graph state to the AI\nassistantRuntime.registerModelContextProvider({\n  getModelContext: () =\u003e ({\n    system: &#96;\n      # Mindmap Graph Context\n      - Total nodes: ${nodes.length}\n      - Active node: ${activeNode ? activeNode.id : 'None'}\n      ...\n    &#96;,\n  }),\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Function Registration\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Registers functions that the AI can call to interact with the graph\nassistantRuntime.registerFunctions({\n  addNote: handleAddNote,\n  findConnections: handleFindConnections,\n  loadRelatedEntities: handleLoadRelatedEntities,\n  updateNodeLabel: handleUpdateNodeLabel,\n  deleteNode: handleDeleteNode,\n  reorganizeLayout: handleReorganizeLayout\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available AI Functions\n\nThe SmartGraph component exposes these functions to the assistant:\n\n| Function | Description | Parameters |\n|----------|-------------|------------|\n| &#96;addNote&#96; | Creates a new user input node | &#96;input: string, position?: {x, y}&#96; |\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Mindmap with Assistant UI Integration"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2

            "lineNumber": 3,

            "text": "## Usage Example"

            "lineNumber": 14

        "originalContents": "# Mindmap with Assistant UI Integration\n\nThis directory contains the mindmap visualization components and integration with Assistant UI.\n\n## AI-Enhanced Graph Features\n\nThe AIEnabledGraph component wraps the standard Graph component with Assistant UI context awareness, enabling:\n\n1. Contextual AI assistance based on the current graph state\n2. Intelligent suggestions based on visible nodes and connections\n3. Direct AI interaction with the graph through function calling\n\n## Usage Example\n\nTo use the AI-enabled graph in a page:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use client'\n\nimport { MindMapProvider } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { AIEnabledGraph } from '@/features/mindmap/smart-graph'\nimport { AssistantProvider } from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport default function MindmapPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cAssistantProvider\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapProvider\u003e\n        \u003cAIEnabledGraph /\u003e\n      \u003c/MindMapProvider\u003e\n    \u003c/AssistantProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## How It Works\n\nThe implementation uses two key Assistant UI patterns:\n\n### 1. Model Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Dynamically exposes the current graph state to the AI\nassistantRuntime.registerModelContextProvider({\n  getModelContext: () =\u003e ({\n    system: &#96;\n      # Mindmap Graph Context\n      - Total nodes: ${nodes.length}\n      - Active node: ${activeNode ? activeNode.id : 'None'}\n      ...\n    &#96;,\n  }),\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Function Registration\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Registers functions that the AI can call to interact with the graph\nassistantRuntime.registerFunctions({\n  addNote: handleAddNote,\n  findConnections: handleFindConnections,\n  loadRelatedEntities: handleLoadRelatedEntities,\n  updateNodeLabel: handleUpdateNodeLabel,\n  deleteNode: handleDeleteNode,\n  reorganizeLayout: handleReorganizeLayout\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available AI Functions\n\nThe SmartGraph component exposes these functions to the assistant:\n\n| Function | Description | Parameters |\n|----------|-------------|------------|\n| &#96;addNote&#96; | Creates a new user input node | &#96;input: string, position?: {x, y}&#96; |\n",

WebSocketStatus.Connecting : WebSocketStatus.Disconnected\n  )\n  const { setIsAiLoading, setAiError } = useContext(EditorContext)\n\n  const editor = useEditor(\n    {\n      immediatelyRender: false,\n      autofocus: true,\n      onCreate: ({ editor }) =\u003e {\n        if (provider) {\n          provider.on('synced', () =\u003e {\n            if (editor.isEmpty) {\n              editor.commands.setContent(initialContent)\n            }\n          })\n        } else {\n          editor.commands.setContent(initialContent)\n          editor.commands.focus('start', { scrollIntoView: true })\n        }\n      },\n      extensions: [\n        ...ExtensionKit({\n          provider,\n        }),\n        provider\n          ?         "contents": "export function useAskXata(options: UseAskXataOptions = {}) {\n\n\n\t...\n\n\n\t// Set up SSE connection\n\tuseEffect(() =\u003e {\n\t\t// Skip if server-side or not streaming\n\t\tif (typeof window === \"undefined\" || !isStreaming) return;\n\t\t\n\t\t// Create connection if needed\n\t\tif (!eventSourceRef.current) {\n\t\t\tconst eventSource = new EventSource(endpoint);\n\t\t\teventSourceRef.current = eventSource;\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t// Connection opened\n\t\t\teventSource.onopen = () =\u003e setIsConnected(true);\n\n\t\t\t// Process messages\n\t\t\teventSource.onmessage = (event) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Raw event data:\", event.data?.substring(0, 100));\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst data = JSON.parse(event.data);\n\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Parsed event data:\", data);\n\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t// Handle streaming text from answer property (not text)\n\t\t\t\t\tif (data.answer) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Processing answer update:\", data.answer.substring(0, 50));\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst newText = fullTextRef.current + data.answer;\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfullTextRef.current = newText;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Directly update state - simpler and more reliable\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsetStreamingText(newText);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Call callback for the consuming component\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif (options.onStreamingUpdate) options.onStreamingUpdate(newText);\n\t\t\t\t\t}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n\t// Set up SSE connection\n\tuseEffect(() =\u003e {\n\t\t// Skip if server-side or not streaming\n\t\tif (typeof window === \"undefined\" || !isStreaming) return;\n\t\t\n\t\t// Create connection if needed\n\t\tif (!eventSourceRef.current) {\n\t\t\tconst eventSource = new EventSource(endpoint);\n\t\t\teventSourceRef.current = eventSource;\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\t// Connection opened\n\t\t\teventSource.onopen = () =\u003e setIsConnected(true);\n\n\t\t\t// Process messages\n\t\t\teventSource.onmessage = (event) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Raw event data:\", event.data?.substring(0, 100));\n\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\tconst data = JSON.parse(event.data);\n\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Parsed event data:\", data);\n\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t// Handle streaming text from answer property (not text)\n\t\t\t\t\tif (data.answer) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\"Processing answer update:\", data.answer.substring(0, 50));\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst newText = fullTextRef.current + data.answer;\n\t\t\t\t\t\tfullTextRef.current = newText;\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Directly update state - simpler and more reliable\n\t\t\t\t\t\tsetStreamingText(newText);\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Call callback for the consuming component\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif (options.onStreamingUpdate) options.onStreamingUpdate(newText);\n\t\t\t\t\t}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function AIMindMapProvider({children}: {children: React.ReactNode}) {\n  // Get mind map utilities from context and store\n  const {getCenter, updateNodeData} = useMindMap()\n  const {addNodes: storeAddNodes, addEdges: storeAddEdges} = useMindMapStore()\n\n  // Create a simple wrapper for the add nodes function\n  const addNodes = useCallback(\n    (nodes: any[]) =\u003e {\n      storeAddNodes(nodes)\n    },\n    [storeAddNodes]\n  )\n\n  // Create a simple wrapper for the add edges function\n  const addEdges = useCallback(\n    (edges: any[]) =\u003e {\n      storeAddEdges(edges)\n    },\n    [storeAddEdges]\n  )\n\n  // Initialize AI loading hook\n  const {loadRecordsWithAI} = useAILoading({\n    addNodes,\n    addEdges,\n    getCenter,\n    updateNodeData,\n  })\n\n  // Check if AI is enabled (has API key)\n  const isAIEnabled = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HAS_OPENAI_API === 'true'\n\n  const contextValue = {\n    loadRecordsWithAI,\n    isAIEnabled,\n  }\n\n  return \u003cAIMindMapContext.Provider value={contextValue}\u003e{children}\u003c/AIMindMapContext.Provider\u003e\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function useExpandCollapse(\n  nodes: Node[],\n  edges: any[],\n  childrenLoaded,\n  {\n    layoutNodes = true,\n    treeWidth = 220,\n    treeHeight = 100,\n  }: UseExpandCollapseOptions = {}\n): { nodes: Node[]; edges: any[] } {\n  return useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!childrenLoaded) {\n      return {\n        nodes,\n        edges,\n      }\n    }\n    const hierarchy = stratify()\n      .id((d: { id: any }) =\u003e d.id)\n      .parentId((d: any) =\u003e edges.find((e: any) =\u003e e.target === d.id)?.source)(\n        nodes\n      )\n      .catch((err: any) =\u003e {\n        console.log('err: ', err)\n      })\n    console.log('hierarchy: ', hierarchy)\n\n    hierarchy\n      .descendants()\n      .forEach(\n        (d: {\n          data: { data: { expandable: boolean; expanded: any } }\n          children: any\n        }) =\u003e {\n          d.data.data.expandable = !!d.children?.length\n          d.children = d.data.data.expanded ? d.children : undefined\n        }\n      )\n\n    const layout = tree()\n      .nodeSize([treeWidth, treeHeight])\n      .separation(() =\u003e 1)\n\n    console.log('layout: ', layout)\n    const root = layoutNodes ? layout(hierarchy) : hierarchy\n    console.log('layout: ', layout)\n\n    return {\n      nodes: root\n        .descendants()\n        .map((d: { data: { data: any; position: any }; x: any; y: any }) =\u003e ({\n          ...d.data,\n          // This bit is super important! We *mutated* the object in the &#96;forEach&#96;\n          // above so the reference is the same. React needs to see a new reference\n          // to trigger a re-render of the node.\n          data: { ...d.data.data },\n          type: 'custom',\n          position: isHierarchyPointNode(d)\n            ? { x: d.x, y: d.y }\n            : d.data.position,\n        })),\n      edges: edges.filter(\n        (edge) =\u003e\n          root.find((h: { id: any }) =\u003e h.id === edge.source) \u0026\u0026\n          root.find((h: { id: any }) =\u003e h.id === edge.target)\n      ),\n    }\n  }, [nodes, edges, layoutNodes, treeWidth, treeHeight, childrenLoaded])\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport function useExpandCollapse(\n  nodes: Node[],\n  edges: any[],\n  childrenLoaded,\n  {\n    layoutNodes = true,\n    treeWidth = 220,\n    treeHeight = 100,\n  }: UseExpandCollapseOptions = {}\n): { nodes: Node[]; edges: any[] } {\n  return useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!childrenLoaded) {\n      return {\n        nodes,\n        edges,\n      }\n    }\n    const hierarchy = stratify()\n      .id((d: { id: any }) =\u003e d.id)\n      .parentId((d: any) =\u003e edges.find((e: any) =\u003e e.target === d.id)?.source)(\n        nodes\n      )\n      .catch((err: any) =\u003e {\n        console.log('err: ', err)\n      })\n    console.log('hierarchy: ', hierarchy)\n\n    hierarchy\n      .descendants()\n      .forEach(\n        (d: {\n          data: { data: { expandable: boolean; expanded: any } }\n          children: any\n        }) =\u003e {\n          d.data.data.expandable = !!d.children?.length\n          d.children = d.data.data.expanded ? d.children : undefined\n        }\n      )\n\n    const layout = tree()\n      .nodeSize([treeWidth, treeHeight])\n      .separation(() =\u003e 1)\n\n    console.log('layout: ', layout)\n    const root = layoutNodes ? layout(hierarchy) : hierarchy\n    console.log('layout: ', layout)\n\n    return {\n      nodes: root\n        .descendants()\n        .map((d: { data: { data: any; position: any }; x: any; y: any }) =\u003e ({\n          ...d.data,\n          // This bit is super important! We *mutated* the object in the &#96;forEach&#96;\n          // above so the reference is the same. React needs to see a new reference\n          // to trigger a re-render of the node.\n          data: { ...d.data.data },\n          type: 'custom',\n          position: isHierarchyPointNode(d)\n            ? { x: d.x, y: d.y }\n            : d.data.position,\n        })),\n      edges: edges.filter(\n        (edge) =\u003e\n          root.find((h: { id: any }) =\u003e h.id === edge.source) \u0026\u0026\n          root.find((h: { id: any }) =\u003e h.id === edge.target)\n      ),\n    }\n  }, [nodes, edges, layoutNodes, treeWidth, treeHeight, childrenLoaded])\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// This function is meant to be called from client components that need streaming\nexport const xataToXYFlow = async ( {\n\tquestion,\n\ttable,\n\trules,\n\tcontext,\n\texistingNodes,\n\tsourceNode,\n\tsessionId,\n\tlayoutType = \"horizontal\",\n\thistoricalFilter,\n\ttourContext,\n}: XataToXYFlowParams ): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResponse\u003e =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Input validation\n\t\tif ( !question || typeof question !== 'string' || question.trim().length === 0 ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid or empty question parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !table || typeof table !== 'string' ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid table parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !sourceNode || !sourceNode.id ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid sourceNode parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !Array.isArray( existingNodes ) ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'xataToXYFlow: existingNodes is not an array, using empty array' )\n\t\t\texistingNodes = []\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🚀 ~ xataToXYFlow ~ question:\", question )\n\n\t\t// Convert rules to array if it's a string\n\t\tconst rulesArray = Array.isArray( rules ) ? rules : [rules]\n\n\t\t// Validate rules array\n\t\tconst validRules = rulesArray.filter( rule =\u003e\n\t\t\trule \u0026\u0026 typeof rule === 'string' \u0026\u0026 rule.trim().length \u003e 0\n\t\t)\n\n\t\tif ( validRules.length === 0 ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'xataToXYFlow: No valid rules provided, using default' )\n\t\t\tvalidRules.push( &#96;Find relevant ${table} records&#96; )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Enhance rules with historical filtering if provided\n\t\tif ( historicalFilter ) {\n\t\t\tconst historicalRules = generateHistoricalFilterRules( historicalFilter, table )\n\t\t\tvalidRules.push( ...historicalRules )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Add tour context rules if in guided mode\n\t\tif ( tourContext \u0026\u0026 tourContext.tourMode === 'guided' ) {\n\t\t\tvalidRules.push( &#96;Following guided tour waypoint: ${tourContext.waypointId}&#96; )\n\t\t\tvalidRules.push( &#96;Tour narrative context: ${tourContext.narrativeContext}&#96; )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst response = await askXataWithAi( {\n\t\t\tquestion,\n\t\t\ttable,\n\t\t\trules: validRules,\n\t\t\tsessionId\n\t\t} )",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch = async ( { subject, type }: RagEnrichmentParams ) =\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Input validation\n    if ( !subject || typeof subject !== 'string' || subject.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Invalid or empty subject parameter' )\n    }\n\n    if ( !type || typeof type !== 'string' || type.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Invalid or empty type parameter' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( &#96;🧠 Initiating RAG enriched search for subject: \"${subject}\" in type: \"${type}\"&#96; )\n\n    const response = await axios.post( '/api/disclosure/data-layer/enrich', {\n      data: {\n        subject: subject.trim(),\n        type: type.trim(),\n      },\n    }, {\n      timeout: 15000, // 15 second timeout for potentially longer RAG operations\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    } )\n\n    if ( !response.data ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: No data received from API' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( '🧠 RAG enriched search response:', response.data )\n    return response.data\n  } catch ( error ) {\n    console.error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Search failed:', error )\n\n    // Return a structured error response\n    if ( axios.isAxiosError( error ) ) {\n      if ( error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' ) {\n        throw new Error( 'RAG enriched search timed out. Please try again.' )\n      } else if ( error.response?.status === 400 ) {\n        throw new Error( 'Invalid search parameters provided' )\n      } else if ( error.response?.status \u003e= 500 ) {\n        throw new Error( 'Server error during RAG enriched search. Please try again later.' )\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new Error( &#96;RAG enriched search failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96; )\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch = async ( { subject, type }: RagEnrichmentParams ) =\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Input validation\n    if ( !subject || typeof subject !== 'string' || subject.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Invalid or empty subject parameter' )\n    }\n\n    if ( !type || typeof type !== 'string' || type.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Invalid or empty type parameter' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( &#96;🧠 Initiating RAG enriched search for subject: \"${subject}\" in type: \"${type}\"&#96; )\n\n    const response = await axios.post( '/api/disclosure/data-layer/enrich', {\n      data: {\n        subject: subject.trim(),\n        type: type.trim(),\n      },\n    }, {\n      timeout: 15000, // 15 second timeout for potentially longer RAG operations\n      headers: {\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n    } )\n\n    if ( !response.data ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: No data received from API' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( '🧠 RAG enriched search response:', response.data )\n    return response.data\n  } catch ( error ) {\n    console.error( 'initiateRagEnrichedDatabaseSearch: Search failed:', error )\n\n    // Return a structured error response\n    if ( axios.isAxiosError( error ) ) {\n      if ( error.code === 'ECONNABORTED' ) {\n        throw new Error( 'RAG enriched search timed out. Please try again.' )\n      } else if ( error.response?.status === 400 ) {\n        throw new Error( 'Invalid search parameters provided' )\n      } else if ( error.response?.status \u003e= 500 ) {\n        throw new Error( 'Server error during RAG enriched search. Please try again later.' )\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new Error( &#96;RAG enriched search failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96; )\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": " {\n    // Determine best layout type based on entity type\n    let layoutType: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'radial' | 'grid' = 'horizontal';\n    \n    // Choose layout based on entity type\n    switch (table) {\n      case 'events':\n        layoutType = 'horizontal';\n        break;\n      case 'personnel':\n      case 'organizations':\n        layoutType = 'radial';\n        break;\n      case 'testimonies':\n        layoutType = 'vertical';\n        break;\n      case 'documents':\n      case 'artifacts':\n        layoutType = 'grid';\n        break;\n      default:\n        layoutType = 'horizontal';\n    }\n    \n    // Get existing nodes\n    const existingNodes = reactFlowInstance.getNodes();\n    \n    // Use xataToXYFlow with appropriate layout type\n    const flowData = await xataToXYFlow({\n      question,\n      table,\n      rules: &#96;Find interesting ${table} records that have clear relationships&#96;,\n      context: &#96;The user is exploring the ${table} database&#96;,\n      existingNodes,\n      sourceNode,\n      layoutType\n    });\n    \n    // Add nodes and edges to the graph\n    if (flowData.nodes \u0026\u0026 flowData.nodes.length \u003e 0) {\n      callbacks.addNodes(flowData.nodes);\n    }\n    \n    if (flowData.edges \u0026\u0026 flowData.edges.length \u003e 0) {\n      callbacks.addEdges(flowData.edges);\n    }\n    \n    // Update source node with results info\n    if (flowData.xataResponse) {\n      callbacks.updateNodeData(sourceNode.id, {\n        entities: flowData.xataResponse.records,\n        answer: flowData.xataResponse.answer,\n        sessionId: flowData.xataResponse.sessionId\n      });\n    }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport const initiateDatabaseTableQuery = async ( {\n  keyword,\n  table,\n}: TableQueryParams ): Promise\u003cSearchResult | undefined\u003e =\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Input validation\n    if ( !keyword || typeof keyword !== 'string' || keyword.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: Invalid or empty keyword parameter' )\n    }\n\n    if ( !table || typeof table !== 'string' || table.trim().length === 0 ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: Invalid or empty table parameter' )\n    }\n\n    // Validate table against known entity types\n    const validTables = ['events', 'personnel', 'organizations', 'testimonies', 'documents', 'sightings', 'topics', 'artifacts']\n    if ( !validTables.includes( table.toLowerCase() ) ) {\n      console.warn( &#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery: Unknown table \"${table}\". Proceeding anyway.&#96; )\n    }\n\n    console.log( &#96;🔍 Searching table \"${table}\" for keyword: \"${keyword}\"&#96; )\n\n    const response = await axios.get( '/api/disclosure/data-layer/search/table', {\n      params: {\n        keyword: keyword.trim(),\n        table: table.trim().toLowerCase(),\n      },\n      timeout: 10000, // 10 second timeout\n    } )\n\n    if ( !response.data ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: No data received from API' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( \"🔍 Table query response:\", response.data )\n\n    // Validate response structure\n    const { data } = response\n    if ( !data || typeof data !== 'object' ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: Invalid response structure' )\n    }\n\n    const {\n      suggestedSearchResult,\n      relatedResults,\n      totalCount\n    } = data\n\n    // Validate required fields\n    if ( !suggestedSearchResult \u0026\u0026 ( !relatedResults || relatedResults.length === 0 ) ) {\n      console.warn( &#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery: No results found for \"${keyword}\" in table \"${table}\"&#96; )\n      return {\n        suggestedSearchResult: { record: null },\n        relatedResults: [],\n        totalCount: 0\n      }\n    }",

Proceeding anyway.&#96; )\n    }\n\n    console.log( &#96;🔍 Searching table \"${table}\" for keyword: \"${keyword}\"&#96; )\n\n    const response = await axios.get( '/api/disclosure/data-layer/search/table', {\n      params: {\n        keyword: keyword.trim(),\n        table: table.trim().toLowerCase(),\n      },\n      timeout: 10000, // 10 second timeout\n    } )\n\n    if ( !response.data ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: No data received from API' )\n    }\n\n    console.log( \"🔍 Table query response:\", response.data )\n\n    // Validate response structure\n    const { data } = response\n    if ( !data || typeof data !== 'object' ) {\n      throw new Error( 'initiateDatabaseTableQuery: Invalid response structure' )\n    }\n\n    const {\n      suggestedSearchResult,\n      relatedResults,\n      totalCount\n    } = data\n\n    // Validate required fields\n    if ( !suggestedSearchResult \u0026\u0026 ( !relatedResults || relatedResults.length === 0 ) ) {\n      console.warn( &#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery: No results found for \"${keyword}\" in table \"${table}\"&#96; )\n      return {\n        suggestedSearchResult: { record: null },\n        relatedResults: [],\n        totalCount: 0\n      }\n    }",

Perfect! Now I understand the issue. The problem is that the client components are trying to import and use the Xata client directly (`import { xata } from "@db/xata/client"`), which should only be used in server-side code.

Looking at the codebase, I can see that:

1. The MindMap component and its child components are client components (marked with `"use client"`)
2. They're importing and using the Xata client directly
3. There are already proper server actions in place that should be used instead

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function fetchNextMindmapRecords(\n\tparams: FetchNextMindmapRecordsParams,\n): Promise\u003cFetchNextMindmapRecordsResult\u003e {\n\tconst { table, size, offset, cursor } = params;\n\n\t// Type-safe way to access the table\n\tconst xataTable = xata.db[table as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataTable:\", xataTable);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Get the dynamic table from xata client\n\n\t\tif (!xataTable) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Table ${table} not found in Xata database&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Offset-based pagination (for initial load or specific positions)\n\t\t// Define the response type\n\t\ttype XataResponse = {\n\t\t\trecords: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tid: string;\n\t\t\t\t[key: string]: unknown;\n\t\t\t\txata: {\n\t\t\t\t\tversion: number;\n\t\t\t\t\tcreatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tupdatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t}\u003e;\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tpage?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcursor: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tmore: boolean;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst response: XataResponse = await xataTable.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Extract records and convert to serializable format\n\t\tconst serializableRecords = response.records.map((record) =\u003e\n\t\t\trecord.toSerializable(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Convert to mind map nodes\n\t\tconst nodes = serializableRecords.map(\n\t\t\t(record: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record),\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record).data,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: table,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tcursor: response.meta.page?.cursor,\n\t\t\t\tmore: response.meta.page?.more,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error fetching records from ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\tsourceNode: ReactFlowNode,\n\texistingNodes: ReactFlowNode[],\n\toriginalType: string,\n\tlayoutType: \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | \"radial\" | \"grid\" = \"horizontal\",\n\tapplyLayout?: (\n\t\tnodes: ReactFlowNode[],\n\t\tedges: ReactFlowEdge[],\n\t\toptions: {\n\t\t\tdirection: \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | \"radial\" | \"grid\";\n\t\t},\n\t) =\u003e ReactFlowNode[],\n): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResult\u003e {\n\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult;\n\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = [];\n\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = [];\n\n\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\tconst centralNodeId = sourceNode.id;\n\n\t// Create nodes for each record with parentId set to the source node\n\tfor (const record of records) {\n\t\tif (!record) continue;\n\n\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\tconst nodeId = record.id;\n\t\tnodes.push({\n\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 }, // Initial position will be set by layout\n\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\tedges.push({\n\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t});\n\t}\n\n\t// Determine the best layout based on number of nodes and type\n\tconst direction = layoutType;\n\tlet spacing = 50;\n\n\t// For radial layouts with many nodes, increase the radius\n\t// by adjusting parentChildSpacing\n\tlet parentChildSpacing = 100;\n\tif (direction === \"radial\" \u0026\u0026 nodes.length \u003e 5) {\n\t\tparentChildSpacing = 120 + nodes.length * 5;         "originalContents": "\n\n// This function is meant to be called from client components that need streaming\nexport const xataToXYFlow = async ({\n\tquestion,\n\ttable,\n\trules,\n\tcontext,\n\texistingNodes,\n\tsourceNode,\n\tsessionId,\n\tlayoutType = \"horizontal\",\n}: XataToXYFlowParams): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResponse\u003e =\u003e {\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataToXYFlow ~ question:\", question);\n\tconst response = await askXataWithAi({ question, table, rules });\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataToXYFlow ~ response:\", response);\n\n\t// Pass the layoutType to transformForReactflow\n\tconst { nodes, edges } = await transformForReactflow(\n\t\tresponse,\n\t\tsourceNode,\n\t\texistingNodes,\n\t\ttable,\n\t\tlayoutType,\n\t);\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ edges:\", edges);\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t// To use with EventSource, we need to provide a callback system\n\tconst streamingUrl = sessionId\n\t\t? &#96;/api/sse/xata/ask/${sessionId}&#96;\n\t\t: \"/api/sse/xata/ask\";\n\n\t// Return an object with methods to start streaming and handle events\n\treturn {\n\t\tnodes,\n\t\tedges,\n\t\txataResponse: {\n\t\t\tanswer: response.answer,\n\t\t\trecords: response.records,\n\t\t\tsessionId: response.sessionId,\n\t\t},\n\t};\n};",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { xata } from \"../client\";\n\nexport const searchXata = async ({\n\tquery,\n\tid,\n\ttable,\n}: {\n\tquery: string;\n\tid?: string | null;\n\ttable?: string | null;\n}) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif (!query) {\n\t\t\treturn { success: false, error: \"Query is required\" };\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tlet searchResults;\n\n\t\tif (table \u0026\u0026 id) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table and record\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.db[table].search(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else if (table) {\n\t\t\t// Search within a specific table\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\ttables: [{ table }],\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t// Global search across all tables\n\t\t\tsearchResults = await xata.search.all(query, {\n\t\t\t\tfuzziness: 1,\n\t\t\t\tprefix: \"phrase\",\n\t\t\t});\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: true,\n\t\t\tsearchResults: searchResults.records || searchResults,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Search error:\", error);\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: false,\n\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t};\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Enhanced Ask Xata function with full SDK support\n * Supports all Xata Ask SDK features including rules, search types, boosters, and filters\n */\nexport const askXata = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions?: {\n\t\trules?: string[];\n\t\tsearchType?: string;\n\t\tsearch?: any;\n\t\tvectorSearch?: any;\n\t\tsessionId?: string;\n\t},\n) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst askOptions = {\n\t\t\trules: options?.rules || [],\n\t\t\tsearchType: options?.searchType || \"table\",\n\t\t\tsearch: options?.search,\n\t\t\tvectorSearch: options?.vectorSearch,\n\t\t\tsessionId: options?.sessionId,\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst result = await xataClient.db[table].ask(question, askOptions);\n\t\treturn result;\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error asking Xata:\", error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n};",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function fetchNextMindmapRecords(\n\tparams: FetchNextMindmapRecordsParams,\n): Promise\u003cFetchNextMindmapRecordsResult\u003e {\n\tconst { table, size, offset, cursor } = params;\n\n\t// Type-safe way to access the table\n\tconst xataTable = xata.db[table as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataTable:\", xataTable);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Get the dynamic table from xata client\n\n\t\tif (!xataTable) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Table ${table} not found in Xata database&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Offset-based pagination (for initial load or specific positions)\n\t\t// Define the response type\n\t\ttype XataResponse = {\n\t\t\trecords: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tid: string;\n\t\t\t\t[key: string]: unknown;\n\t\t\t\txata: {\n\t\t\t\t\tversion: number;\n\t\t\t\t\tcreatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tupdatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t}\u003e;\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tpage?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcursor: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tmore: boolean;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst response: XataResponse = await xataTable.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Extract records and convert to serializable format\n\t\tconst serializableRecords = response.records.map((record) =\u003e\n\t\t\trecord.toSerializable(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Convert to mind map nodes\n\t\tconst nodes = serializableRecords.map(\n\t\t\t(record: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record),\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record).data,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: table,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tcursor: response.meta.page?.cursor,\n\t\t\t\tmore: response.meta.page?.more,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error fetching records from ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",
