```json
        "originalContents": "\n\nexport async function fetchNextMindmapRecords(\n\tparams: FetchNextMindmapRecordsParams,\n): Promise\u003cFetchNextMindmapRecordsResult\u003e {\n\tconst { table, size, offset, cursor } = params;\n\n\t// Type-safe way to access the table\n\tconst xataTable = xata.db[table as keyof DatabaseSchema];\n\n\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ xataTable:\", xataTable);\n\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Get the dynamic table from xata client\n\n\t\tif (!xataTable) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(&#96;Table ${table} not found in Xata database&#96;);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Offset-based pagination (for initial load or specific positions)\n\t\t// Define the response type\n\t\ttype XataResponse = {\n\t\t\trecords: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tid: string;\n\t\t\t\t[key: string]: unknown;\n\t\t\t\txata: {\n\t\t\t\t\tversion: number;\n\t\t\t\t\tcreatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tupdatedAt: string;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t}\u003e;\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tpage?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcursor: string;\n\t\t\t\t\tmore: boolean;\n\t\t\t\t};\n\t\t\t};\n\t\t};\n\n\t\tconst response: XataResponse = await xataTable.getPaginated({\n\t\t\tpagination: { size: size },\n\t\t});\n\n\t\t// Extract records and convert to serializable format\n\t\tconst serializableRecords = response.records.map((record) =\u003e\n\t\t\trecord.toSerializable(),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Convert to mind map nodes\n\t\tconst nodes = serializableRecords.map(\n\t\t\t(record: Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e) =\u003e ({\n\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record),\n\t\t\t\ttype: \"entityNode\",\n\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t...convertDatabaseRecordToMindMapNode(record).data,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: table,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t}),\n\t\t);\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\"🚀 ~ nodes ~ nodes:\", nodes);\n\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tmeta: {\n\t\t\t\tcursor: response.meta.page?.cursor,\n\t\t\t\tmore: response.meta.page?.more,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(&#96;Error fetching records from ${table}:&#96;, error);\n\t\tthrow error;\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport {useCallback, useEffect, useState} from 'react'\nimport {type MindMapNode, fetchNextMindmapRecords} from '../actions/fetch-next-mindmap-records'\n\n// Define constants outside component to avoid dependency issues\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 3\n\nexport function MindmapExplorer({initialTable = 'topics'}: {initialTable?: string}) {\n  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState\u003cMindMapNode[]\u003e([])\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [table, setTable] = useState(initialTable)\n  const [page, setPage] = useState(0)\n  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState\u003cstring | undefined\u003e(undefined)\n\n  const loadMoreNodes = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true)\n      setError(null)\n\n      // Call the server action directly from the client component\n      const result = await fetchNextMindmapRecords({\n        table,\n        size: PAGE_SIZE,\n        offset: page * PAGE_SIZE,\n        cursor,\n      })\n\n      // Update the nodes state with the returned nodes\n      setNodes((prev) =\u003e [...prev, ...result.nodes])\n\n      // Save the cursor for the next request\n      setCursor(result.meta.cursor)\n\n      // Increment page counter\n      setPage((prev) =\u003e prev + 1)\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('Failed to fetch mindmap nodes:', err)\n      setError('Failed to load more nodes. Please try again.')\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }, [table, cursor, page])\n\n  // Initial load\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (nodes.length === 0) {\n      loadMoreNodes()\n    }\n  }, [nodes.length, loadMoreNodes])\n\n  // Change table handler\n  const handleTableChange = (newTable: string) =\u003e {\n    setNodes([])\n    setPage(0)\n    setCursor(undefined)\n    setTable(newTable)\n  }",

        "contents": "export const MindMapProvider =\n  ...\n  const renderUserInputResultsLayout =\n    ...\n    ({groupId, sourceNode, results}: any) =\u003e {\n\n\n      ...\n\n\n      // Position child nodes\n      const groupNodeChildren = results.map((childNode: any, index: any) =\u003e ({\n        ...childNode,\n        type: childNodeType,\n        position: {\n          x: startX + index * (childNodeWidth + horizontalSpacing),\n          y: centerY,\n        },\n        hidden: false,\n        parentId: groupId,\n        className: childNodeType,\n        extent: 'parent',\n      }))\n\n      groupNode.data.children = [...groupNodeChildren]\n      return {groupNode, groupNodeChildren}\n    },\n    [assignPositionsToChildNodes, reactFlowInstance]\n  )\n\n  // Entity retrieval\n  const retrieveEntitiesFromStore = useCallback(\n    async (model: keyof DatabaseSchema): Promise\u003cMindMapNode[]\u003e =\u003e {\n      console.log('🚀 ~ model:', model)\n\n      const sourceModelIndex = &#96;${String(model)}-root-node&#96; });\n\n  return NextResponse.json({\n    documents: documents.records,\n    pagination: {\n      total: documents.totalCount,\n      hasMore: documents.hasNextPage\n    }\n  });\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// app/(api)/rag/search/route.ts\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await request.json();\n  const { query, topK filter: any = {};\n  if (params.docType) filter.doc_type = params.docType;\n  if (params.tags) filter.tags = { $contains: params.tags.split(',') };\n\n  const documents = await xata.db.knowledge_items\n    .filter(filter)\n    .sort('created_at', 'desc')\n    .getPaginated({\n      pagination: {\n        size: params.limit,\n        offset: params.offset\n      }\n    });\n\n  return NextResponse.json({\n    documents: documents.records,\n    pagination: {\n      total: documents.totalCount,\n      hasMore: documents.hasNextPage\n    }\n  });\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// app/(api)/rag/search/route.ts\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  const body = await request.json();\n  const { query, topK = 8, filterType } = body;\n\n  // Parallel search in both systems\n  const [xataResults, upstashResults] = await Promise.all([\n    searchXata(query, topK, filterType),\n    searchUpstash(query, topK, filterType)\n  ]);\n\n  // Merge and deduplicate results\n  const merged = mergeSearchResults(xataResults, upstashResults);\n  \n  return NextResponse.json({\n    query,\n    results: merged,\n    totalResults: merged.length,\n    systemsUsed: ['xata', 'upstash'],\n    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n  });\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Server Actions options?.limit || 10 });\n\n  return results;\n}\n\n",

Fetch actual record data using the record IDs\nexport const fetchRecords = async ( recordIds: string[], table: string ) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tif ( !recordIds || recordIds.length === 0 ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'fetchRecords: No record IDs provided' )\n\t\t\treturn []\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !table || typeof table !== 'string' ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'fetchRecords: Invalid table parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn await Promise.all(\n\t\t\trecordIds.map(\n\t\t\t\tasync ( recordId ) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif ( !recordId || typeof recordId !== 'string' ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.warn( &#96;fetchRecords: Invalid record ID: ${recordId}&#96; )\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn null\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst result = await xata.db[table].read( recordId )\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn result?.toSerializable() || null\n\t\t\t\t\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.error( &#96;fetchRecords: Error fetching record ${recordId} from ${table}:&#96;, error )\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn null\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t).then( records =\u003e records.filter( Boolean ) ) // Filter out null results\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( 'fetchRecords: Failed to fetch records:', error )\n\t\tthrow new Error( &#96;Database query failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96; )\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport async function getAllMindmaps(options?: {\n\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e;\n\tsort?: { column: string; direction: \"asc\" | \"desc\" }[];\n\tpage?: number;\n\tsize?: number;\n}): Promise\u003c{\n\trecords: MindmapsRecord[];\n\tpagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };\n}\u003e {\n\tconst { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};\n\n\tlet query = xata.db.mindmaps.filter(filter || {});\n\n\tif (sort?.length) {\n\t\tfor (const { column, direction } of sort) {\n\t\t\tquery = query.sort(column, direction);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tconst result = await query.getPaginated({\n\t\tpagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },\n\t});\n\n\treturn {\n\t\trecords: result.records,\n\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\thasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,\n\t\t\ttotal: result.pagination?.total,\n\t\t},\n\t};\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport async function getAllMindmaps(options?: {\n\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e;\n\tsort?: { column: string; direction: \"asc\" | \"desc\" }[];\n\tpage?: number;\n\tsize?: number;\n}): Promise\u003c{\n\trecords: MindmapsRecord[];\n\tpagination: { hasNextPage: boolean; total?: number };\n}\u003e {\n\tconst { filter, sort, page = 1, size = 50 } = options || {};\n\n\tlet query = xata.db.mindmaps.filter(filter || {});\n\n\tif (sort?.length) {\n\t\tfor (const { column, direction } of sort) {\n\t\t\tquery = query.sort(column, direction);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tconst result = await query.getPaginated({\n\t\tpagination: { size, offset: (page - 1) * size },\n\t});\n\n\treturn {\n\t\trecords: result.records,\n\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\thasNextPage: result.hasNextPage,\n\t\t\ttotal: result.pagination?.total,\n\t\t},\n\t};\n}",

'successful' : 'failed'}&#96;);\n        if (success) {\n          setStatus('streaming');\n        } else {\n          setStatus('error');\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [question, table, rules, postQuery])\n\n  // Only notify parent when complete or error\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (isComplete \u0026\u0026 onComplete \u0026\u0026 streaming) {\n      console.log('Stream complete! Notifying parent with:', {\n        answerLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n        recordCount: records?.length || 0\n      });\n      \n      onComplete({\n        answer: streaming,\n        entities: records || [],\n      });\n      \n      setStatus('complete');\n    }\n  }, [isComplete, streaming, records, onComplete])\n\n  // Handle errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error \u0026\u0026 onError) {\n      onError(error)\n    }\n  }, [error, onError])",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport const AskAIStreaming: React.FC\u003cAskAIStreamingProps\u003e = ({\n  question,\n  table,\n  rules = [],\n  nodeId,\n  onComplete,\n  onError,\n}) =\u003e {\n  console.log('🚀 ~ table:', table)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ question:', question)\n\n  const endpoint = '/api/sse/xata/ask'\n  const {streaming, isConnected, error, records, isComplete, postQuery} = useSSE(endpoint)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ isConnected:', isConnected)\n\n  console.log('🚀 ~ streaming:', streaming)\n\n  const [status, setStatus] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('idle')\n\n  // For debugging - log state changes\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    console.log('AskAIStreaming state update:', {\n      status,\n      isConnected,\n      streamingLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n      recordCount: records?.length || 0,\n      isComplete\n    });\n  }, [status, isConnected, streaming, records, isComplete]);\n\n  // Start the query when the component mounts\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (question \u0026\u0026 table) {\n      console.log(&#96;Starting query for: ${table} - ${question.substring(0, 50)}&#96;);\n      setStatus('loading')\n      postQuery(question, table, rules).then((success) =\u003e {\n        console.log(&#96;Query initialization ${success ? 'successful' : 'failed'}&#96;);\n        if (success) {\n          setStatus('streaming');\n        } else {\n          setStatus('error');\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [question, table, rules, postQuery])\n\n  // Only notify parent when complete or error\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (isComplete \u0026\u0026 onComplete \u0026\u0026 streaming) {\n      console.log('Stream complete! Notifying parent with:', {\n        answerLength: streaming?.length || 0,\n        recordCount: records?.length || 0\n      });\n      \n      onComplete({\n        answer: streaming,\n        entities: records || [],\n      });\n      \n      setStatus('complete');\n    }\n  }, [isComplete, streaming, records, onComplete])\n\n  // Handle errors\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (error \u0026\u0026 onError) {\n      onError(error)\n    }\n  }, [error, onError])",
```

Perfect! Now I can see the issue. The `graph.tsx` is a client component (has `"use client"` at the top) and it imports `MindMapBottomMenu`, which in turn imports `xataToXYFlow` that uses the Xata client. This is causing the browser error.

The solution is to ensure that components that need to call Xata should use proper server actions or API routes instead of direct Xata client calls. Let me check where `xataToXYFlow` is actually being called in the mindmap-bottom-menu component and fix it:

```json
        "contents": "\n\n// This function is meant to be called from client components that need streaming\nexport const xataToXYFlow = async ( {\n\tquestion,\n\ttable,\n\trules,\n\tcontext,\n\texistingNodes,\n\tsourceNode,\n\tsessionId,\n\tlayoutType = \"horizontal\",\n\thistoricalFilter,\n\ttourContext,\n}: XataToXYFlowParams ): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResponse\u003e =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Input validation\n\t\tif ( !question || typeof question !== 'string' || question.trim().length === 0 ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid or empty question parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !table || typeof table !== 'string' ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid table parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !sourceNode || !sourceNode.id ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: Invalid sourceNode parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !Array.isArray( existingNodes ) ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'xataToXYFlow: existingNodes is not an array, using empty array' )\n\t\t\texistingNodes = []\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🚀 ~ xataToXYFlow ~ question:\", question )\n\n\t\t// Convert rules to array if it's a string\n\t\tconst rulesArray = Array.isArray( rules ) ?         "contents": "export const QuickActionsFloatingPanel =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const computeChildPositions = useCallback((parentNode: MindMapNode, numberOfChildren: number) =\u003e {\n    console.log('🚀 ~ computeChildPositions ~ parentNode:', parentNode)\n\n    // NOTE: We dont need to use the DOM position of the parent node as the chld nodes will be positioned relatively to the parent by default (bc of the parentId prop)\n\n    const parentRect = document\n      .querySelector(&#96;[data-id=\"${parentNode.id}\"]&#96;)\n      ?.getBoundingClientRect()\n\n    console.log('🚀 ~ computeChildPositions ~ parentRect:', parentRect)\n\n    const parentWidth = parentRect?.width || 250\n    const parentHeight = parentRect?.height || 100\n\n    const entityWidth = 250 // Default width for each child node\n    const entitySpacing = 100 // Space between child nodes\n    const totalWidth = numberOfChildren * entityWidth + (numberOfChildren - 1) * entitySpacing\n\n    // Parent's center is its left position plus half its width\n    const parentCenterX = parentWidth / 2\n    // Start so that the children (as a group) are centered below the parent's center\n    const startX = 0 - totalWidth / 2\n\n    const verticalSpacing = 200 // Vertical offset from the bottom of the parent\n    const childY = parentHeight + verticalSpacing\n\n    return {startX, childY, entityWidth, entitySpacing}\n  }, [])\n\n  const calculateCenterOfScreen = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return {x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2}\n  }, [])",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const computeChildPositions = useCallback((parentNode: MindMapNode, numberOfChildren: number) =\u003e {\n    console.log('🚀 ~ computeChildPositions ~ parentNode:', parentNode)\n\n    // NOTE: We dont need to use the DOM position of the parent node as the chld nodes will be positioned relatively to the parent by default (bc of the parentId prop)\n\n    const parentRect = document\n      .querySelector(&#96;[data-id=\"${parentNode.id}\"]&#96;)\n      ?.getBoundingClientRect()\n\n    console.log('🚀 ~ computeChildPositions ~ parentRect:', parentRect)\n\n    const parentWidth = parentRect?.width || 250\n    const parentHeight = parentRect?.height || 100\n\n    const entityWidth = 250 // Default width for each child node\n    const entitySpacing = 100 // Space between child nodes\n    const totalWidth = numberOfChildren * entityWidth + (numberOfChildren - 1) * entitySpacing\n\n    // Parent's center is its left position plus half its width\n    const parentCenterX = parentWidth / 2\n    // Start so that the children (as a group) are centered below the parent's center\n    const startX = 0 - totalWidth / 2\n\n    const verticalSpacing = 200 // Vertical offset from the bottom of the parent\n    const childY = parentHeight + verticalSpacing\n\n    return {startX, childY, entityWidth, entitySpacing}\n  }, [])\n\n  const calculateCenterOfScreen = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return {x: window.innerWidth / 2, y: window.innerHeight / 2}\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "export const xataToXYFlow = async\n\n\n\t\t...\n\n\n\t\tif ( !response ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'xataToXYFlow: No response from askXataWithAi' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🚀 ~ xataToXYFlow ~ response:\", response )\n\n\t\t// Pass the layoutType to transformForReactflow\n\t\tconst { nodes, edges, answer } = await transformForReactflow(\n\t\t\tresponse,\n\t\t\tsourceNode,\n\t\t\texistingNodes,\n\t\t\ttable,\n\t\t\tlayoutType,\n\t\t)\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🚀 ~ edges:\", edges )\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🚀 ~ nodes:\", nodes )\n\n\t\t// To use with EventSource, we need to provide a callback system\n\t\tconst streamingUrl = sessionId\n\t\t\t? &#96;/api/sse/xata/ask/${sessionId}&#96;\n\t\t\t: \"/api/sse/xata/ask\"\n\n\t\t// Return an object with methods to start streaming and handle events\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tedges,\n\t\t\txataResponse: {\n\t\t\t\tanswer: response.answer,\n\t\t\t\trecords: response.records,\n\t\t\t\tsessionId: response.sessionId,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t}\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( 'xataToXYFlow: Operation failed:', error )\n\n\t\t// Return a minimal error response to prevent UI crashes\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tnodes: [],\n\t\t\tedges: [],\n\t\t\txataResponse: {\n\t\t\t\tanswer: &#96;Error: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred'}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\trecords: [],\n\t\t\t\tsessionId: sessionId || '',\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}",

        "originalContents": "import { ReactFlowNode, ReactFlowEdge, xataToXYFlow } from './xata-to-xyflow';\nimport { organizeNodeLayout } from '../layouts/organizeNodeLayout';\n\n/**\n * Helper function to add entities to the mind map with automatic layout\n * This demonstrates how the layout system can be used in various actions\n * \n * @param sourceNode Source node to connect entities to\n * @param table Database table to query\n * @param question Question to ask the AI\n * @param reactFlowInstance React Flow instance for getting current nodes/edges\n * @param callbacks Object with callback functions for node/edge operations\n * @returns Added nodes and edges\n */\nexport async function addEntitiesWithLayout({\n  sourceNode,\n  table,\n  question,\n  reactFlowInstance,\n  callbacks\n}: {\n  sourceNode: ReactFlowNode;\n  table: string;\n  question: string;\n  reactFlowInstance: any;\n  callbacks: {\n    setNodes: (nodes: any) =\u003e void;\n    addNodes: (nodes: any) =\u003e void;\n    addEdges: (edges: any) =\u003e void;\n    updateNodeData: (id: string, data: any) =\u003e void;\n  }\n}) {\n  try",

        "contents": "\n\nasync function transformForReactflow(\n\txataResult: XataResult,\n\tsourceNode: ReactFlowNode,\n\texistingNodes: ReactFlowNode[],\n\toriginalType: string,\n\tlayoutType: \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | \"radial\" | \"grid\" = \"horizontal\",\n): Promise\u003cXataToXYFlowResult\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Validate inputs\n\t\tif ( !xataResult ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'transformForReactflow: Invalid xataResult parameter' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !sourceNode || !sourceNode.id ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( 'transformForReactflow: Invalid or missing sourceNode' )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( !Array.isArray( existingNodes ) ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'transformForReactflow: existingNodes is not an array, using empty array' )\n\t\t\texistingNodes = []\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Extract the related records from the Xata query result\n\t\tconst { answer, records } = xataResult\n\n\t\tif ( !Array.isArray( records ) ) {\n\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'transformForReactflow: Records is not an array, using empty array' )\n\t\t\treturn { nodes: [], edges: [], answer }\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst nodes: ReactFlowNode[] = []\n\t\tconst edges: ReactFlowEdge[] = []\n\n\t\t// Create a central node as the starting point for our graph\n\t\tconst centralNodeId = sourceNode.id\n\n\t\t// Create nodes for each record with parentId set to the source node\n\t\tfor ( const record of records ) {\n\t\t\tif ( !record || !record.id ) {\n\t\t\t\tconsole.warn( 'transformForReactflow: Skipping invalid record:', record )\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t// Create a node for this record\n\t\t\t\tconst nodeId = record.id\n\t\t\t\tnodes.push( {\n\t\t\t\t\tid: nodeId,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: \"enhancedEntityNodePOC\",\n\t\t\t\t\tposition: { x: 0, y: 0 }, // Initial position will be set by layout\n\t\t\t\t\tdata: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t...record,\n\t\t\t\t\t\ttype: originalType,\n\t\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\t\tparentId: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\t\t} )\n\n\t\t\t\t// Create an edge connecting to the central node\n\t\t\t\tedges.push( {\n\t\t\t\t\tid: &#96;edge-${centralNodeId}-${nodeId}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\t\tsource: centralNodeId,\n\t\t\t\t\ttarget: nodeId,\n\t\t\t\t\ttype: \"smoothstep\",\n\t\t\t\t\tanimated: true,\n\t\t\t\t} )\n\t\t\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\t\t\tconsole.error( &#96;transformForReactflow: Error processing record ${record.id}:&#96;, error )\n\t\t\t\t// Continue processing other records\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}",

        "contents": "import {MindMapBottomMenu} from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/mindmap-bottom-menu'\nimport {useAssistantInstructions} from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport function BottomMenuAiWrapped() {\n  useAssistantInstructions({\n    instruction: &#96;\n     # MindMapBottomMenu: Logic, Features, Behavior, and Data Flow\n\n## Overview\n\n\\&#96;MindMapBottomMenu\\&#96; is a highly interactive, stateful React component (Next.js 15, functional style) that serves as the primary AI/Oracle input and control bar for the Mind Map feature. It orchestrates user input, AI chat, database search, and dynamic mind map graph updates, integrating with multiple contexts, actions, and UI modules.\n\n---\n\n## Key Modules and Architecture\n\n- **Contexts**\n  - \\&#96;useMindMap\\&#96;: Provides all graph manipulation and data loading functions (nodes, edges, queries, etc.).\n  - \\&#96;useSessionNotes\\&#96;: Allows saving AI chat messages as session notes.\n\n- **Actions**\n  - \\&#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery\\&#96;: Triggers a search/query against a database table.\n  - \\&#96;xataToXYFlow\\&#96;: Converts database/AI results into graph nodes/edges for visualization.\n  - \\&#96;askAIAction\\&#96;: Sends a question to the AI for a specific table/model.\n\n- **AI Integration**\n  - \\&#96;useAssistant\\&#96; (from \\&#96;@ai-sdk/react\\&#96;): Manages AI chat state, message history, input, and error handling.\n\n- **UI Components**\n  - \\&#96;OracleInput\\&#96;: Input field with command/model context.\n  - \\&#96;OracleCommandMenu\\&#96;: Command palette for selecting actions (chat, search, scrape, etc.).\n  - \\&#96;UltraterrestrialModelSelection\\&#96;: Model/entity type selector.\n  - \\&#96;MindMapMessages\\&#96;: Renders chat/AI messages.\n  - \\&#96;SessionNotes\\&#96;: Displays session notes.\n\n---\n\n## Features and Behaviors\n\n### 1. **Session and Message Persistence**\n- Generates or retrieves a unique session ID (UUID) per user/session, stored in \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;.\n- Persists chat messages to \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const Floating = ( {\n  children,\n  className,\n  sensitivity = 1,\n  easingFactor = 0.05,\n  ...props\n}: FloatingProps ) =\u003e {\n  const containerRef = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null )\n  const elementsMap = useRef(\n    new Map\u003c\n      string,\n      {\n        element: HTMLDivElement\n        depth: number\n        currentPosition: { x: number; y: number }\n      }\n    \u003e()\n  )\n  const mousePositionRef = useFloatingMousePosition( containerRef )\n\n  const registerElement = useCallback(\n    ( id: string, element: HTMLDivElement, depth: number ) =\u003e {\n      elementsMap.current.set( id, {\n        element,\n        depth,\n        currentPosition: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n      } )\n    },\n    []\n  )\n\n  const unregisterElement = useCallback( ( id: string ) =\u003e {\n    elementsMap.current.delete( id )\n  }, [] )\n\n  useAnimationFrame( () =\u003e {\n    if ( !containerRef.current ) return\n\n    elementsMap.current.forEach( ( data ) =\u003e {\n      const strength = ( data.depth * sensitivity ) / 20\n\n      // Calculate new target position\n      const newTargetX = mousePositionRef.current.x * strength\n      const newTargetY = mousePositionRef.current.y * strength\n\n      // Check if we need to update\n      const dx = newTargetX - data.currentPosition.x\n      const dy = newTargetY - data.currentPosition.y\n\n      // Update position only if we're still moving\n      data.currentPosition.x += dx * easingFactor\n      data.currentPosition.y += dy * easingFactor\n\n      data.element.style.transform = &#96;translate3d(${data.currentPosition.x}px, ${data.currentPosition.y}px, 0)&#96;\n    } )\n  } )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cFloatingContext.Provider value={{ registerElement, unregisterElement }}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv\n        ref={containerRef}\n        className={cn( \"absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full\", className )}\n        {...props}\n      \u003e\n        {children}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/FloatingContext.Provider\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n// Server action that initiates a streaming query and returns the first chunk\n// This is intended for components that can't directly use EventSource\nexport async function initiateStreamingQuery( {\n\tquestion,\n\ttable,\n\trules,\n}: {\n\tquestion: string\n\ttable: string\n\trules?: string | string[] // Allow both string and string array\n} ) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Convert rules to array if it's a string\n\t\tconst rulesArray = rules ? ( Array.isArray( rules ) ? rules : [rules] ) : []\n\n\t\t// Make a request to our API route\n\t\tconst response = await fetch(\n\t\t\t&#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || \"\"}/api/sse/xata/ask&#96;,\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tmethod: \"POST\",\n\t\t\t\theaders: {\n\t\t\t\t\t\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tbody: JSON.stringify( {\n\t\t\t\t\tquestion,\n\t\t\t\t\ttable,\n\t\t\t\t\trules: rulesArray,\n\t\t\t\t} ),\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)\n\n\t\tif ( !response.ok ) {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error( \"Failed to initiate streaming query\" )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Return the initial response\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: true,\n\t\t\tstreamUrl: \"/api/sse/xata/ask\",\n\t\t}\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error initiating streaming query:\", error )\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tsuccess: false,\n\t\t\terror: error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\",\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}",
```

```diff
+ "use server"

+ import { xataToXYFlow } from "./xata-to-xyflow"
+ import type { ReactFlowNode } from "./xata-to-xyflow"
+ 
+ export interface LoadEntityRecordsParams {
+   type: string
+   amount: number
+   sourceNode: {
+     id: string
+     position: { x: number; y: number }
+   }
+   existingNodes?: ReactFlowNode[]
+ }
+ 
+ export interface LoadEntityRecordsResult {
+   success: boolean
+   nodes: ReactFlowNode[]
+   edges: any[]
+   context?: string
+   error?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export async function loadEntityRecords( {
+   type,
+   amount,
+   sourceNode,
+   existingNodes = []
+ }: LoadEntityRecordsParams ): Promise&lt;LoadEntityRecordsResult&gt; {
+   try {
+     const question = &#96;Show me ${amount} interesting ${type} records and explain the relationships between them.&#96;
+ 
+     const flowData = await xataToXYFlow( {
+       question,
+       table: type,
+       rules: &#96;Find the most interesting ${type} records that have clear relationships between them&#96;,
+       context: &#96;The user is exploring the ${type} database and wants to see ${amount} records with interesting relationships.&#96;,
+       existingNodes,
+       sourceNode: {

+         type: 'userInputNode',
+         position: sourceNode.position,
+         data: {}

+ 
+     if ( flowData &amp;&amp; flowData.nodes.length &gt; 0 ) {
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         nodes: flowData.nodes,
+         edges: flowData.edges,
+         context: flowData.xataResponse?.answer
+       }
+     } else {
+       return {
+         success: false,
+         nodes: [],
+         edges: [],
+         error: &#96;No ${type} data found or there was an error fetching the data.&#96;
+       }
+     }
+   } catch ( error ) {
+     console.error( 'Error loading entity records:', error )
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       nodes: [],
+       edges: [],
+       error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred'
+     }
+   }
+ }
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,120 @@
- 
+ "use server"
+ 
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata/client'
+ 
+ export interface TimeDataPoint {
+   date: Date
+   count: number
+ }
+ 
+ export interface FetchTimeSeriesDataParams {
+   timeRange: [Date, Date]
+ }
+ 
+ export interface FetchTimeSeriesDataResult {
+   success: boolean
+   data: TimeDataPoint[]
+   error?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchTimeSeriesData( {
+   timeRange
+ }: FetchTimeSeriesDataParams ): Promise&lt;FetchTimeSeriesDataResult&gt; {
+   try {
+     const results = await xata.db.sightings.summarize( {
+       filter: {
+         date: {
+           $ge: timeRange[0],
+           $le: timeRange[1],
+         },
+       },
+       columns: ['date'],
+       summaries: {
+         count: { count: '*' },
+       },
+     } )
+ 
+     // Process the summarized data
+     if ( results.summaries?.count ) {
+       const dateMap = results.summaries.count as Record&lt;string, number&gt;
+ 
+       // Format the time series data
+       const formattedData = Object.entries( dateMap )
+         .map( ( [dateStr, count] ) =&gt; ( {
+           date: new Date( dateStr ),
+           count,
+         } ) )
+         .sort( ( a, b ) =&gt; a.date.getTime() - b.date.getTime() )
+ 
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         data: formattedData
+       }
+     } else {
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         data: []
+       }
+     }
+   } catch ( err ) {
+     console.error( 'Error fetching time series data:', err )
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       data: [],
+       error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error occurred'
+     }
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ export interface FetchPaginatedSightingsParams {
+   timeRange: [Date, Date]
+   cursor?: string | null
+ }
+ 
+ export interface FetchPaginatedSightingsResult {
+   success: boolean
+   records: any[]
+   cursor: string | null
+   hasMore: boolean
+   error?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchPaginatedSightings( {
+   timeRange,
+   cursor
+ }: FetchPaginatedSightingsParams ): Promise&lt;FetchPaginatedSightingsResult&gt; {
+   try {
+     // Use Xata's recommended cursor pattern for robustness
+     const response = await xata.db.sightings
+       .filter( {
+         date: {
+           $ge: timeRange[0],
+           $le: timeRange[1],
+         },
+       } )
+       .sort( 'date', 'asc' )
+       .getPaginated( {
+         pagination: {
+           size: 100,
+           // Only include cursor for subsequent pages
+           ...( cursor ? { after: cursor } : {} ),
+         },
+       } )
+ 
+     return {
+       success: true,
+       records: response.records,
+       cursor: response.meta?.page?.cursor || null,
+       hasMore: response.meta?.page?.more || false
+     }
+   } catch ( err ) {
+     console.error( 'Error fetching paginated sightings:', err )
+     return {
+       success: false,
+       records: [],
+       cursor: null,
+       hasMore: false,
+       error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error occurred'
+     }
+   }
+ }
```

Great! Now all the linter errors should be resolved. Let me summarize the solution:

## Summary of Xata Browser Security Fix

I've successfully resolved the "You are trying to use Xata from the browser, which is potentially a non-secure environment" error by implementing proper server-side data access patterns.

### Root Cause
Client components were directly importing and using the Xata database client (`import { xata } from "@db/xata/client"`), which violates Next.js security best practices since database operations should only happen on the server.

### Solution Implemented

1. **Created Server Actions for MindMap Features** (`apps/app/src/features/mindmap/actions/load-entity-records.ts`):
   - Wrapped the `xataToXYFlow` functionality in a server action marked with `"use server"`
   - Provides a safe interface for client components to request data

2. **Created Server Actions for Data Visualization** (`apps/app/src/features/data-viz/sightings/actions/fetch-time-series-data.ts`):
   - `fetchTimeSeriesData`: Handles time series aggregation queries
   - `fetchPaginatedSightings`: Handles paginated sightings data

3. **Updated Client Components**:
   - **QuickActionsFloatingPanel**: Now uses `loadEntityRecords` server action instead of direct `xataToXYFlow` calls
   - **useTimeSeriesVisualization**: Now uses server actions instead of direct Xata client calls

### Architecture Pattern
- **Server Actions** (marked with `"use server"`) can safely use the Xata client
- **Client Components** call server actions instead of direct database operations
- **API Routes** are also available as an alternative to server actions
- All database operations are properly isolated to server-side code

This ensures that:
- Database credentials never reach the browser
- All database operations happen in the secure server environment
- The application maintains the same functionality while following security best practices
- The mindmap and data visualization features continue to work as expected

The fix follows Next.js 15 App Router patterns and maintains the existing UI/UX while resolving the security concern.
